patch_resolves_note: The authoritative fixed-image run from n132/arvo:42527319-fix on July 28, 2026 stayed clean while still executing `rtcm3_length_extract` and `crc_span_call`. At the root site it recorded masked `data_len=768` instead of the vulnerable `54016`, confirming that the real fixed program enforces the RTCM3 10-bit length obligation before continuing into the CRC path.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code statement on the crashing path that consumes the witness into parser-dispatch state by classifying the post-space `0xff` byte as a Zodiac leader.

Root cause. Once `packet_parse()` rescans the recognized buffer and chooses `idx == 0`, this assignment forms `data_len` from the full next two bytes without enforcing RTCM3's 10-bit length field. The actual recognized leader byte `0xd3` at `inbuffer[1]` is therefore misused as the high length byte, yielding `data_len == 0xD300`.

AddressSanitizer sink. The CRC loop dereferences `data[i]` while `i` is driven by the inflated length derived after `packet_parse()` rescans from `idx == 0` and misinterprets the next `0xd3` as length data, so the read eventually leaves the stack `lexer` object.
In `RTCM3_RECOGNIZED`, the rescan stops at `idx == 0`, so the parser chooses the earlier rejected `0xd3` at the start of the live buffer as the basis for later length extraction.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original emits `rtcm3_rescan selected_idx=0 zero_literal=0` before the length calculation.

nodes.description: Intermediate runtime event crc_span_call materialized from verified transition assertion transition.data_len_carries_to_crc_span_call.

edges.description: The same rescan-selected `idx` value is consumed by the vulnerable length extraction, so the earlier rejected leader byte determines which bytes populate `data_len`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original records ordered events `rtcm3_rescan` then `rtcm3_length_extract`, with `selected_idx=0` at both points.

edges.description: The extracted `data_len` value is reused unchanged at the CRC call site, where it becomes the basis for the claimed packet span.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original records ordered events `rtcm3_length_extract` then `crc_span_call`, and both carry `data_len=54016`.
